title: Routing decision playback and sampled-context snapshots for RCA
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem statement: When a customer reports degraded quality or a spike in latency we currently lack a compact, privacy-safe mechanism to reconstruct the exact routing context and per-hop runtime state. Existing decision logs capture high-level routing outcomes but not the sampled encoder/decoder KV state, prefix-cache hits, or the per-hop resource attribution needed for deterministic root-cause analysis (RCA) and replay. This ticket designs a play-backable "routing snapshot" artifact that correlates decision metadata, per-hop metrics, and a deterministic minimal execution context for offline repro and fast RCA.
goals: 1) Define a compact routing snapshot schema sufficient to replay or simulate the routing decision and estimate per-hop costs offline. 2) Add sampled, privacy-sanitized context capture at decision time for a configurable fraction of requests and for all classified errors (>=P1 errors). 3) Surface playback tooling in Console: searchable snapshots, playback execution in a safe sandbox, and a link from traces to the corresponding snapshot. 4) Ensure snapshots are encrypted at rest and can be scrubbed for PII on-demand.
non_goals: Do not keep full token-level KV caches for all requests. This is not a replacement for full request logging in compliance-only customers; this is an observability artifact for engineering RCA and runbook automation.
success_metrics: 1) Mean time to root cause for routing-related incidents reduced by 30% in Q2. 2) % time engineers spend on instrumentation data shipping reduced by 40%. 3) No increase in cost >5% for hosted observability retention budget under default sampling.
design_summary: Snapshot artifact fields (compact, all fields documented below): request_id, routing_decision_id, timestamp, policy_version, selected_region, selected_tier, fallback_applied (yes/no), chosen_model_variant, candidate_scores (top-3) as short floats, route_reason_tokens (short text reason code), per_hop_metrics as summarized strings (hop_index: latency_ms, compute_gflop_est, kv_cache_hit_ratio), cache_prefix_fingerprint (sha256 prefix), deterministic_seed_for_replay, sampling_reason (random|error|manual), scrub_level (none|partial|full). We will NOT store raw user prompt text unless the customer has enabled retention and has accepted a higher scrub_level. For privacy the default snapshot will store prompt fingerprints and prompt length buckets instead of raw text.
schema_notes: Snapshots are intentionally shallow: per_hop_metrics will be a compact CSV string like '0:12,0.12,0.75;1:5,0.05,1.00' representing hop:latency_ms,gflop_est,kv_hit_ratio. Candidate_scores limited to three models with normalized scores. Deterministic_seed_for_replay plus policy_version allow deterministic rerun in the sandbox using identical routing inputs but without raw user text. Encryption: AES-256-GCM and customer-managed KMS option for Private deployments.
sampling_policy: Default: 0.5% random sample of requests stored for 7 days. Error override: 100% for any request that triggers a routing error or quality-regression alert. Customer override: allow per-tenant sampling multiplier and allow 'always-log' toggle for support-enabled tenants. Also support on-demand manual capture via Console 'Capture snapshot' action linked to a request trace.
storage_retention: Default retention 7 days in hot store, 90 days in cold archive for PII-free snapshots. Encrypted blobs for higher-sensitivity snapshots stored for 30 days unless customer requests deletion. Admin console action to purge snapshots for a tenant or request id.
tradeoffs:
- Storing richer context improves RCA but increases storage and risk of PII leakage. We mitigate with fingerprinting and scrub levels.
- Deterministic playback without raw prompt will only estimate model outputs; for full fidelity we require opt-in raw prompt retention which is gated by security review.
- Sampling reduces coverage; to compensate we prioritize errors and high-impact customers.
- Implementing playback sandbox adds maintenance surface for runtime; we favor a limited simulator plus hooks into a dedicated replay cluster rather than running replays against production GPUs.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (spike): 2wk spike to implement snapshot schema, storage backend, and a simple Console list view. Phase 2 (core): instrument routing decision path to emit snapshots, wire sampling policy, add trace correlation and link. Phase 3 (playback): build sandbox replay runner (cpu-sim + light model runtimes) and a secure UI to trigger replays. Phase 4 (rollout): AB test sampling rate and validate cost impact. Timeline: Phase 1 done, Phase 2 in progress, Phase 3 planned after security review.
rollout_steps: 1) Feature flag behind 'routing.snapshot' (disabled by default). 2) Enable for internal tenants and SRE team. 3) Gradual ramp to 0.5% in hosted; enable 100% for dedicated debug tiers if tenant requests. 4) Monitor storage and error-rate correlation dashboards for two weeks before broader roll.
security_considerations: PII handling by default fingerprinting; explicit opt-in required for prompt text retention. All snapshots encrypted at rest and in transit. Access controls: only users with 'observability:read' can view snapshots in Console. Audit log entries created on snapshot read and deletion. Security review ticket required and created: SECR-2026-34.
api_changes: Add new endpoint GET /internal/routing_snapshots?request_id=<id>&tenant=<id> for SRE/console use. POST /internal/routing_snapshots/query for filtered lookups. Console will call internal endpoints via service account. Endpoints require 'snapshots:read' scope and are rate-limited.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot schema documented in Confluence and approved by security.
Routing path emits snapshots at configured sampling rates without increasing p99 latency by more than 5ms.
Console list view with links from traces implemented and RBAC enforced.
Sandbox replay reproduces per-hop latency ordering deterministically for sampled snapshots (within noise).
